dogecoin.text:
@gomez_brilliant When you hold on a cold wallet with keys stored offline, your holdings are as safe as Bitcoin/Dogecoin/your crypto of choice can be.

Hardware wallets reduce drastically the risk also when attempting to spend that crypto, even on a compromised machine.

There are no developers hoarding large chunks of the supply; there are no mysterious teams with mysterious allegiances running #Dogecoin, just a bunch of shibes that are part of the community. 

You can be a developer, too.

#Dogecoin is a crypto𝘤𝘶𝘳𝘳𝘦𝘯𝘤𝘺 with its own blockchain. It has nothing in common with those "dog" tokens exchanges have been trying to market under the same category.

Dogecoin was not made for short term speculation, but to be used and shared - use it, build for it.

Let me use my usual simile:

Using these tools is a bit like playing Russian roulette against the dude who made the gun and knows in which chamber the bullet is located. Or who can make it magically materialize in that chamber, if he wants to.

#Dogecoin

@DogeBosshere This is a good question. It is better to hold in your private wallet, for many reasons, including the fact the exchange might be "playing" with your Dogecoin in ways you do not want them to (like lending out to speculators).

But... (1/n)

Buy small amounts at a time with pocket money, over a prolonged period of time, to average the risk.

If you have house money, use it to buy a house. Farm money, use it for your farm. Student loans, use them for studying! Family savings, do not touch them. #Dogecoin

Be smart: https://t.co/i7l2whuww0

As #Dogecoin is doing fairly well today, I know some newbies will start once again having the idea of playing with margin accounts, leverage, and derivatives: do not do it.

Many shibes went this route last year and lost most of their savings - heartbreaking. Be smart! https://t.co/DdKLZeE6SY
Our @Oonabot also added a contest for meme makers, which are really the true lifeblood of #Dogecoin.

The CEO of @Krakenfx, @jespow, recently advised people not to hold on centralized exchanges - which is extraordinary, and exactly what we are trying to explain to shibes holding too much #Dogecoin on exchanges and brokerage services.

https://t.co/4MJwIRaHFW

Here you can see @KrakenFx clearly stating what an exchange is: not a wallet for holding, but a place for trading, and they then proceed to recommend hardware wallets for holding.

Every exchange should be this crystal-clear about this.

#Dogecoin #crypto

https://t.co/zLutNTe1hi

@delasoul202 Always encrypt the wallet with Dogecoin Core, but REMEMBER to store the encryption password somewhere safe. 

Many lost access to millions worth of Doge because of a missing password - they might have been able to brute force it, but do not end up in that situation.

@delasoul202 It have used it for a long time. You can use it to generate a wallet, and then store the wallet.dat file (and a private key dump) in several USB keys that you can store offline; you will basically then have your #Dogecoin in cold storage.
